newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air cargo up 7.5pct in March, 5.8pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: German air cargo up 7.5pct in March, 5.8pct in Q1.

text.p: The German air cargo market grew 7.5 percent in March to 188,467 tonnes from the same month last year, figures from the German airports association ADV show.
In the first quarter of 1997, air cargo flown to and from the 16 international German airports increased 5.8 percent, the monthly ADV traffic report said.
Exports grew more strongly than imports both in March and over the first quarter, it added.
Frankfurt airport, which accounts for 67 percent of all German airfreight, handled 7.9 percent more cargo in March and 5.1 percent more in the first quarter.
Strong double-figure growth was shown at Duesseldorf, Munich and Nuremberg airports from January-March, the ADV said.
